name: confirm
subject: Confirm it is you on Permaily

blocks.text: Your code to confirm it is you on Permaily:
Type it where you were asked for it. It works once, for 10 minutes.
If you did not ask for it, someone may be signed in to your account: sign in at app.permaily.com, open Settings and sign out the devices you do not know. Nothing changes without the code.
